run_loss_comp_plot: run the python script to generate a contour plot of a loss landscape and save it as loss-comp.pdf
run_figure_generation: run the script to create a filled contour plot with overlaid contour lines and a scatter marker at the origin
run_meshgrid_visualization: run the script to visualize a 2D meshgrid-based loss function using numpy and matplotlib
run_pdfcrop_output: run the script to generate and auto-crop a PDF figure using pdfcrop for publication-quality output
run_contour_scatter_plot: run the script to plot a quadratic loss surface with a sigmoid transform and mark the optimal point
